Name: Meraioth, Son of Zerahiah
Summary: Son of Zerahiah and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:6; 1 Chronicles 6:52: Son of Zerahiah and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Meraioth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
